title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Cryptocurrency Portfolio Optimization
body: We propose a deep reinforcement learning framework for dynamic portfolio allocation across Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana. Our model processes order-book features and macroeconomic signals to outperform equal-weight and Markowitz baselines by 23% Sharpe ratio on 2023-2024 data. The approach handles non-stationarity via rolling recalibration windows.

title: Transformer-Based Limit Order Book Forecasting with Sparse Attention
body: We introduce SparseOBT, a transformer architecture with block-sparse attention for mid-price prediction from limit order book data. Evaluated on BTC-USD and ETH-USD Coinbase snapshots, SparseOBT achieves 4.1 bps lower MAE versus LSTM baselines while reducing inference latency by 40%. Code and datasets are released.

title: On the Microstructure of DeFi Liquidity Pools and Impermanent Loss
body: This paper analyzes on-chain data from Uniswap v3 concentrated liquidity pools to model impermanent loss as a function of price volatility and rebalancing frequency. We derive closed-form bounds for ETH-USD LP positions and empirically validate against 18 months of Ethereum mainnet data.

title: Bitcoin Spot ETF Flows Hit Record High as Institutions Pile In
body: Bitcoin ETF products from BlackRock and Fidelity recorded combined inflows of $1.4 billion in a single day, the highest since launch. Analysts say the surge reflects growing institutional appetite for regulated BTC exposure. The price of Bitcoin climbed 3.2% on the news.

title: Ethereum Gas Fees Drop 90% After Dencun Upgrade Takes Full Effect
body: Transaction costs on the Ethereum network have fallen dramatically following the full adoption of EIP-4844 proto-danksharding. Layer-2 networks including Arbitrum and Optimism now settle blobs at sub-cent costs. ETH burned per block has decreased, reducing deflationary pressure.

title: Solana DePIN Projects Attract $500M in New Funding
body: Decentralized physical infrastructure networks built on Solana have raised half a billion dollars in Q2 2026. Projects spanning wireless networks, GPU compute, and sensor data are driving SOL on-chain activity to new highs. Total locked value on Solana surpassed $15 billion.

title: SEC Approves Final Crypto Broker-Dealer Framework After Years of Deliberation
body: The Securities and Exchange Commission voted 3-2 to adopt a new regulatory framework allowing registered broker-dealers to custody digital assets. The framework covers Bitcoin and Ethereum under existing securities law. Industry groups called it a long-awaited regulatory clarity milestone.

title: MicroStrategy Inc — 8-K (2026-06-09)
body: MicroStrategy Inc filed an 8-K with the SEC on 2026-06-09 reporting the acquisition of an additional 1,500 Bitcoin at an average price of $72,450 per coin, bringing total holdings to 226,500 BTC.

title: Sentiment-Augmented Price Prediction for Crypto Assets Using LLM Embeddings
body: We fine-tune a sentence transformer on crypto-Twitter posts and SEC filings to generate sentiment embeddings for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana. Combined with OHLCV features, the augmented model yields statistically significant alpha over pure price-based models. We also release CryptoSentDB, a labeled dataset of 120k posts.

title: NVIDIA Reports Record Crypto Mining GPU Sales in Q1 2026
body: NVIDIA disclosed that its data center and gaming GPU divisions saw elevated demand from cryptocurrency mining operations in Q1 2026. The H100 GPU continues to dominate AI training workloads while the RTX 4090 remains popular for Ethereum-related proof-of-work derivatives. Revenue guidance was raised by 8%.

title: BTC-ETH Correlation Breaks Down as Ethereum Outperforms
body: The 30-day rolling correlation between Bitcoin and Ethereum fell to 0.62 in June 2026, the lowest in two years. Analysts attribute the divergence to Ethereum-specific catalysts including restaking yield demand and DePIN activity on Solana ecosystem forks.

title: Coinbase Global Inc — 10-Q (2026-06-10)
body: Coinbase Global Inc filed a 10-Q with the SEC on 2026-06-10. The filing disclosed $1.2B in trading revenue for Q1 2026, a 45% increase year-over-year driven by Bitcoin and Ethereum spot trading volumes.
